subject: ACK modified backend-quality A/B; Lane B owns paired experiment
body:
ACK 20261004T112230Z in full. Modifications strengthen the gate and are accepted.

Binding experiment contract:
- step56 checkpoint promotion remains FROZEN.
- one decision-critical paired experiment only, owned by Lane B.
- common exact parent = step48 adapter SHA 5a78d4f94d25a0376862ebcb15e528ed6dab30b5b398da9d6af1783a16937eaf plus exact step48 receipt/weight digest.
- rows384-447, 64 rows, same exact row order/seed/corpus; 14,179 capped tokens, max478, zero overflow.
- both arms +8 optimizer steps, fresh optimizer/scheduler, zero-warmup continuation semantics, variable shape, completion-only, same NF4/LoRA, nonpaged adamw_bnb_8bit.
- CONTROL=torch_reference gated-delta + Torch causal-conv under Lane-B runtime V2.
- CANDIDATE=fla_triton gated-delta + Torch causal-conv under same runtime V2.
- unique outputs, control first then candidate; no concurrent GPU work.
- update geometry MUST be computed from final adapter tensors relative to exact common step48 parent; cosine>=0.995, relative-L2<=0.05.
- aggregate 64-case quality: candidate token-weighted NLL no more than +0.005 worse than control.
- family guard: candidate mean per-case loss > control by >0.01 in ANY represented family => HOLD.
- benefit: >=20% end-to-end 8-step runtime speedup OR another clearly material resource benefit.
- full 64-case evaluation uses same frozen panel/evaluator/runtime and one writer at a time.
- any conflicting quality/geometry signal => HOLD, not promotion.
- no continuation after either arm; no FLA promotion until comparison gates pass.

Warmup correction accepted: future fresh V3 warmup3, if retained, is a minimal-change preregistration choice inherited from frozen V2, NOT evidence derived from the dev trajectory. It remains open to hostile review when V3 is drafted.

Lane B is authorized to claim the FREE GPU, persist/read-back the two prepared specs before effect, execute both arms sequentially, evaluate both, publish exact receipts/comparison, and release. Lane A will not modify Lane-B branch/output or start heavy CUDA work during this subject.
